title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-27
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Well‑recorded wet night at Red Rocks captures Phil’s booming bass on Playing in the Band and The Other One, delivering a solid, spacey performance despite rain.
ai_review.review: The audience (FOB) recording by Jim Wise is praised for its clarity and fidelity, with only a brief cut of the crowd outro. The show is described as an average‑to‑good set that shines on Phil Lesh’s massive bass moments in Playing in the Band and The Other One, and it left listeners feeling “nothing but space.”

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show/recording 4 stars and highlight strong bass work and good recording quality, while two give zero stars, creating mixed signals; overall the performance and sound are solid but not universally praised.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hand‑held FOB capture with top‑notch clarity and fidelity; occasional rain ambience; crowd outro cut early, losing some ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid average set that maintains energy despite wet conditions; transitions flow well enough for a pleasant listening experience.

band_member_comments.Phil: Underwater stage but delivered huge bass notes and big fat chords on Playing in the Band and The Other One.
